quiz.question: The committee recommended that he ___ the position immediately.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive memakai bentuk dasar kata kerja untuk semua subjek, tanpa '-s'.

quiz.question: It is essential that she ___ present at the meeting.
quiz.explanation: Subjunctive dengan To Be selalu memakai bentuk dasar 'be', tidak peduli subjeknya.

quiz.question: If I ___ you, I would reconsider that decision.
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive memakai 'were' untuk semua orang, termasuk I/he/she/it.

quiz.question: The judge insisted that the witness ___ the truth.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive setelah 'insist' memakai bentuk dasar 'tell'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct fixed formulaic subjunctive phrase.
quiz.explanation: 'Long live the king' adalah frasa arkaik yang membeku, memakai bentuk dasar 'live'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He demanded that she leaves immediately."
options: He demanded that she leave immediately
He demanded that she left immediately
He demanded that she is leaving immediately
He demanded that she will leave immediately
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'demand', mandative subjunctive memakai bentuk dasar tanpa '-s': 'leave'.

quiz.question: The negative mandative subjunctive doesn't use which auxiliary?
quiz.explanation: Negasi mandative subjunctive tidak memakai do/does/did; cukup letakkan 'not' sebelum kata kerja.

quiz.question: It was recommended that he not ___ any further comments.
quiz.explanation: Negasi subjunctive: 'not' + bentuk dasar, tanpa 'do/does/did'.

quiz.question: If she ___ more careful, this situation could have been avoided.
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive konsisten memakai 'were' untuk kondisi yang berlawanan dengan fakta.

quiz.question: In diplomatic and ethical discourse, using the subjunctive reflects:
options: sensitivity and formality appropriate to sensitive matters
quiz.explanation: Di level C2, subjunctive adalah instrumen diplomasi yang menunjukkan kepekaan terhadap konteks formal.

quiz.question: The board requires that every member ___ present at the annual meeting.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive dengan To Be memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I wish I was taller" — formal alternative using subjunctive.
options: I wish I have been taller
I wish I will be taller
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive formal memakai 'were', bukan 'was', meski keduanya umum dipakai.

quiz.question: Choose the correct formulaic subjunctive expression.
quiz.explanation: 'God bless you' adalah frasa arkaik tetap yang memakai bentuk dasar 'bless'.

quiz.question: The proposal suggests that the policy ___ revised before implementation.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive pasif: bentuk dasar 'be' + Verb 3.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "It is important that he does not to be late."
options: It is important that he not be late
It is important that he doesn't be late
It is important that he not is late
It is important that he will not be late
quiz.explanation: Negasi subjunctive: 'not' + bentuk dasar 'be', tanpa 'does'.

quiz.question: If the truth ___ known, the entire situation would be viewed differently.
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive pasif memakai 'were' + Verb 3.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting formal international diplomacy using subjunctive.
options: The delegation insists that the treaty be honored by all parties
The delegation insists that the treaty is honored by all parties
The delegation insists that the treaty was honored by all parties
The delegation insists that the treaty will be honored by all parties
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive dipakai dalam konteks diplomasi formal untuk permintaan yang mengikat.

quiz.question: The elder advised that the young man ___ patient during hardship.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive setelah 'advise' memakai bentuk dasar 'remain'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "If I were rich, I will travel the world."
options: If I were rich, I would travel the world
If I was rich, I will travel the world
If I am rich, I would travel the world
If I were rich, I travel the world
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive dipasangkan dengan 'would', bukan 'will', untuk kondisi tidak nyata.

quiz.question: Choose the correct formulaic subjunctive for a farewell blessing.
quiz.explanation: 'Peace be upon you' adalah frasa formulaic subjunctive yang tetap, memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

quiz.question: The court demands that the defendant ___ before the judge tomorrow.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive formal dalam konteks hukum memakai bentuk dasar 'appear'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "It is vital that everyone follows the rules." (subjunctive form)
options: It is vital that everyone follow the rules
It is vital that everyone followed the rules
It is vital that everyone will follow the rules
It is vital that everyone is following the rules
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive memakai bentuk dasar tanpa '-s': 'follow'.

quiz.question: If he ___ more diplomatic, the negotiation might have succeeded.
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive konsisten memakai 'were'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting sensitivity in ethical/formal discourse.
options: We propose that the committee reconsider its stance with due sensitivity
We propose that the committee reconsiders its stance
We propose that the committee reconsidered its stance
We propose that the committee will reconsider its stance
quiz.explanation: Subjunctive dalam konteks etis/formal mencerminkan kepekaan dan formalitas.

quiz.question: The regulation stipulates that all documents ___ submitted by Friday.
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive pasif dalam bahasa hukum/regulasi memakai 'be' + Verb 3.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "So be it, whatever will happens."
quiz.explanation: 'So be it' adalah frasa formulaic tetap yang memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

quiz.question: The council requested that the new policy not ___ enforced until further review.
quiz.explanation: Negasi subjunctive: 'not be' + Verb 3, tanpa 'do/does/did'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about maintaining honesty in speech (Sidiq) using subjunctive formally.
options: It is essential that every statement be verified before it is shared
It is essential that every statement is verified before shared
It is essential that every statement was verified before shared
It is essential that every statement will be verified before shared
quiz.explanation: Subjunctive formal menekankan pentingnya verifikasi sebelum menyampaikan informasi (menghindari fitnah).

quiz.question: If she ___ in his position, she would have handled it differently.
quiz.explanation: Hypothetical Subjunctive memakai 'were' untuk semua subjek dalam kondisi tidak nyata.

quiz.question: Choose the correct mandative subjunctive in a formal recommendation letter.
options: I recommend that she be granted the scholarship
I recommend that she is granted the scholarship
I recommend that she was granted the scholarship
I recommend that she will be granted the scholarship
quiz.explanation: Mandative subjunctive formal dalam surat rekomendasi memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat mandative subjunctive setelah kata kerja seperti recommend/insist/demand. [HINT] Kata kerja setelahnya selalu bentuk dasar, tanpa -s.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat hypothetical subjunctive menggunakan were untuk situasi yang tidak nyata. [HINT] Were dipakai untuk semua subjek, termasuk I/he/she.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat negatif mandative subjunctive tanpa auxiliary do/does/did. [HINT] Cukup letakkan not sebelum kata kerja dasar.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat formal dalam konteks etika/diplomasi menggunakan subjunctive. [HINT] Subjunctive menunjukkan kepekaan dan formalitas tinggi.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan frasa formulaic subjunctive tetap (seperti Long live, God bless, Peace be upon). [HINT] Ini adalah jejak arkaik yang sudah membeku sebagai frasa tetap.

quiz.question: In no way ___ we compromise our principles.
quiz.explanation: 'In no way' memicu inversi negatif: auxiliary 'should' sebelum subjek 'we'.

quiz.question: Only then ___ he realize the depth of his error.
quiz.explanation: 'Only then' memicu inversi pada klausa UTAMA: auxiliary 'did' sebelum subjek.

quiz.question: Not until the results were announced ___ the true impact become clear.
quiz.explanation: 'Not until' memicu inversi pada klausa utama, bukan klausa yang mengikutinya.

quiz.question: ___ you have any concerns, please contact us immediately.
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion tanpa 'if': 'Should you have' menggantikan 'If you should have'.

quiz.question: ___ I known the consequences, I would have acted differently.
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion untuk Third Conditional: 'Had I known' menggantikan 'If I had known'.

quiz.question: Down the ancient corridor ___ echoes of forgotten voices.
quiz.explanation: Locative inversion (tanpa auxiliary) untuk efek puitis/sastra: Place + Verb + Subject.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence with Only when triggering inversion in the main clause.
options: Only when we face hardship do we truly understand patience
Only when we face hardship we do truly understand patience
Only when we do face hardship we understand patience
Only when do we face hardship we understand patience
quiz.explanation: 'Only when' di klausa pertama memicu inversi pada klausa UTAMA ('do we understand'), bukan klausa 'only when' itu sendiri.

quiz.question: Nestled between the mountains, ___ a small, peaceful village.
quiz.explanation: Participle inversion (Nestled...) diikuti langsung Verb + Subject tanpa auxiliary, untuk deskripsi sastra.

quiz.question: In this argument, emphasis is everything; inversion helps to:
options: highlight crucial points in a discourse or piece of advice (Da'wah)
quiz.explanation: Inversi membantu menonjolkan poin krusial dalam argumen atau nasihat (Dakwah).

quiz.question: ___ she known about the risks, she would never have agreed.
quiz.explanation: 'Had she known' adalah conditional inversion untuk 'If she had known'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Only then he realized his mistake."
options: Only then did he realize his mistake
Only then he did realize his mistake
Only then had he realize his mistake
Only then he realizing his mistake
quiz.explanation: 'Only then' memicu inversi: auxiliary 'did' sebelum subjek 'he'.

quiz.question: ___ any doubts arise, we shall address them promptly.
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion formal: 'Should any doubts arise' menggantikan 'If any doubts should arise'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence with Not until triggering inversion in the main clause.
options: Not until the sun set did they finish their journey
Not until the sun set they did finish their journey
Not until did the sun set they finish their journey
Not until the sun did set they finished their journey
quiz.explanation: 'Not until' di klausa pertama memicu inversi pada klausa UTAMA: 'did they finish'.

quiz.question: Perched atop the ancient wall, ___ a lone falcon surveying the land.
quiz.explanation: Participle inversion untuk efek deskriptif tanpa auxiliary.

quiz.question: ___ we know the true extent of the damage until the inspection was complete.
quiz.explanation: 'Not until' memicu inversi pada klausa utama untuk menekankan keterlambatan kesadaran.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Were I to know the truth, I will tell you."
options: Were I to know the truth, I would tell you
Were I to know the truth, I tell you
Were I know the truth, I would tell you
Was I to know the truth, I would tell you
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion formal 'Were I to' dipasangkan dengan 'would', bukan 'will'.

quiz.question: In no way ___ this decision be reversed without proper deliberation.
quiz.explanation: 'In no way' memicu inversi: modal 'should' sebelum subjek 'this decision'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence using locative inversion for a dramatic scene description.
options: Across the vast desert stretched an endless sea of golden sand
Across the vast desert an endless sea of golden sand stretched
Across the vast desert did stretch an endless sea of sand
Across the vast desert stretches an endless sea of sand (present, tense mismatch)
quiz.explanation: Locative inversion: Place + Verb + Subject, tanpa auxiliary, untuk efek dramatis.

quiz.question: ___ he arrived sooner, he could have prevented the misunderstanding.
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion untuk 'If he had arrived' menjadi 'Had he arrived'.

quiz.question: Only by remaining steadfast ___ one overcome such profound trials.
quiz.explanation: 'Only by' memicu inversi dengan modal 'can' sebelum subjek 'one'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Not until she apologized he forgave her."
options: Not until she apologized did he forgive her
Not until she apologized he did forgive her
Not until did she apologize he forgave her
Not until she apologize did he forgive her
quiz.explanation: 'Not until' di klausa pertama memicu inversi di klausa utama: 'did he forgive'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct high-level rhetorical inversion for asserting a firm principle in Da'wah.
options: Under no circumstances should we abandon justice, even when it is difficult
Under no circumstances we should abandon justice
Under no circumstances did we abandon justice
Under no circumstances abandon we should justice
quiz.explanation: 'Under no circumstances' memicu inversi dengan modal 'should' untuk menegaskan prinsip yang kuat.

quiz.question: Emerging from the shadows, ___ a figure few had expected to see.
quiz.explanation: Participle inversion untuk efek naratif dramatis tanpa auxiliary.

quiz.question: ___ any objections be raised, the committee will review them formally.
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion formal 'Should any objections be raised' menggantikan 'If any objections should be raised'.

quiz.question: Only after much reflection and prayer ___ she make her final decision.
quiz.explanation: 'Only after' memicu inversi dengan auxiliary 'did' di klausa utama.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Were she to ask for help, we help her."
options: Were she to ask for help, we would help her
Were she to ask for help, we help her (wrong as is)
Was she to ask for help, we would help her
Were she ask for help, we would help her
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion formal dipasangkan dengan 'would' pada klausa hasil.

quiz.question: Beneath the surface of calm waters ___ currents of great strength.
quiz.explanation: Locative inversion untuk efek deskriptif dramatis: Place + Verb + Subject.

quiz.question: ___ this principle be compromised, the integrity of the entire system would collapse.
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion formal 'Should this principle be compromised' menggantikan 'If this principle should be compromised'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence correctly using 'Only' with main clause inversion for emphasis on truth (Haqq).
options: Only through sincerity does one attain true closeness to Allah
Only through sincerity one does attain true closeness
Only through sincerity one attains true closeness (missing inversion)
Only through sincerity does attain one true closeness
quiz.explanation: 'Only through' memicu inversi pada klausa utama: 'does one attain'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Had I known better, I acted differently."
options: Had I known better, I would have acted differently
Had I known better, I act differently
Had I know better, I would have acted differently
Had I known better, I would act differently (mismatched)
quiz.explanation: Conditional inversion untuk Third Conditional dipasangkan dengan 'would have + Verb 3'.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan Only/Not Until yang memicu inversi pada klausa UTAMA, bukan klausa pemicunya. [HINT] Only/Not until + klausa, lalu auxiliary + subjek di klausa utama.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat conditional inversion formal (Should.../Had.../Were...) tanpa kata 'if'. [HINT] Balik posisi auxiliary dan subjek, hilangkan if.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat locative/participle inversion untuk deskripsi sastra atau puitis. [HINT] Place/participle + verb + subject, tanpa auxiliary tambahan.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat retorika kuat untuk menegaskan prinsip (seperti keadilan atau kebenaran) menggunakan inversi tingkat tinggi. [HINT] Contoh: In no way should we..., Under no circumstances...
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat dakwah yang santun namun tegas menggunakan inversi untuk menekankan poin penting. [HINT] Inversi membantu menonjolkan poin krusial dalam nasihat.

quiz.question: ___ that finally convinced the council to act.
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menempatkan fokus langsung setelah 'It was', menepis kemungkinan pelaku lain.

quiz.question: ___ we truly need is not more resources, but better management.
quiz.explanation: Wh-Cleft 'What' memposisikan seluruh klausa sebagai subjek untuk membangun ketegangan dramatis.

quiz.question: Choose the Reversed Wh-Cleft structure.
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft membalik urutan: fokus diletakkan di depan, diikuti 'is/was + what clause'.

quiz.question: Patience ___ what truly defines a person of strong character.
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft: [Focus: Patience] + is + [what clause].

quiz.question: ___ she wants is a moment of genuine understanding, nothing more.
quiz.explanation: All-Cleft menunjukkan bahwa hanya ada satu hal yang penting/diinginkan.

quiz.question: ___ Allah who guides whomever He wills, and none other.
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menegaskan prinsip iman dengan tegas, menepis kemungkinan lain.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence using It-Cleft to exclude other possible causes.
options: It was his sincerity, not his wealth, that earned him respect
It his sincerity was, not his wealth, that earned him respect
His sincerity it was that earned him respect, not his wealth
It was that his sincerity earned him respect, not his wealth
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menonjolkan satu elemen (sincerity) dan menepis kemungkinan lain (wealth) sebagai penyebab.

quiz.question: ___ he did was betray the trust placed in him.
quiz.explanation: Wh-Cleft menekankan tindakan yang dilakukan, membangun ketegangan sebelum mengungkap fokusnya.

quiz.question: Sincerity in worship ___ what the Prophet emphasized above all.
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft: fokus (Sincerity) di depan, diikuti 'is + what clause'.

quiz.question: ___ matters in the sight of Allah is the state of one's heart, not outward appearance.
quiz.explanation: All-Cleft menekankan eksklusivitas: hanya satu hal yang benar-benar penting.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "It was during the trial which his patience was truly tested."
options: It was during the trial that his patience was truly tested
It during the trial was that his patience was tested
It was during the trial who his patience was tested
During the trial it was that his patience was tested
quiz.explanation: Untuk waktu/peristiwa, gunakan 'that', bukan 'which', setelah It-Cleft dengan frasa waktu.

quiz.question: Choose the correct Reversed Wh-Cleft emphasizing a direct, surprising answer.
options: Honesty is what built the foundation of his success
What built the foundation of his success is honesty (regular Wh-Cleft, less reversed emphasis)
It is honesty what built the foundation
That honesty is what built the foundation
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft: fokus (Honesty) langsung di depan, memberikan jawaban tegas dan mengejutkan.

quiz.question: ___ truly needed was not sympathy, but practical support.
quiz.explanation: Wh-Cleft menekankan kebutuhan sebenarnya, membangun ketegangan sebelum fokus diungkap.

quiz.question: ___ is Allah who sustains every soul, in ease and hardship alike.
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menegaskan prinsip iman secara tegas dan jelas (Haqq).

quiz.question: Choose the correct All-Cleft expressing simplicity and exclusivity.
options: All I ask is for a chance to prove myself
What I ask is for a chance to prove myself (less exclusive nuance)
It is a chance I ask for to prove myself
That I ask is for a chance to prove myself
quiz.explanation: 'All I ask is...' memberikan kesan fokus tunggal dan kejujuran yang mendalam.

quiz.question: Humility ___ what distinguishes a truly wise scholar from an arrogant one.
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft: fokus (Humility) di depan, diikuti 'is + what clause'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "It was the scholar's wisdom which earned him such reverence."
options: It was the scholar's wisdom that earned him such reverence
It the scholar's wisdom was that earned him reverence
It was the scholar's wisdom whom earned him reverence
The scholar's wisdom it was that earned him reverence
quiz.explanation: Untuk konsep abstrak seperti 'wisdom', gunakan 'that', bukan 'which', dalam struktur It-Cleft.

quiz.question: ___ he lacked was not knowledge, but the courage to act on it.
quiz.explanation: Wh-Cleft menekankan kekurangan sebenarnya, membangun ketegangan naratif.

quiz.question: ___ I want is for justice to prevail, nothing more and nothing less.
quiz.explanation: All-Cleft menegaskan kesederhanaan dan kejujuran keinginan (keadilan).

quiz.question: Choose the sentence emphasizing truth (Haqq) with the strongest possible assertion.
options: It is the truth, and the truth alone, that will ultimately prevail
It the truth is that will ultimately prevail
The truth it is that will ultimately prevail
It is truth which will ultimately prevail
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menegaskan kebenaran secara paling tegas, menepis segala keraguan.

quiz.question: Gratitude ___ what transforms hardship into a source of spiritual growth.
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft: fokus (Gratitude) di depan, diikuti 'is + what clause'.

quiz.question: ___ she needed to hear was words of genuine comfort, not empty platitudes.
quiz.explanation: Wh-Cleft membangun ketegangan sebelum mengungkap kebutuhan sebenarnya.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "All that matter is the sincerity of one's intention."
options: All that matters is the sincerity of one's intention
All that matter are the sincerity of intentions
All matter is the sincerity of intention
All that matters are the sincerity of intention
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'All that' dianggap tunggal, jadi memakai 'matters', bukan 'matter'.

quiz.question: ___ is not wealth that defines nobility, but character and conduct.
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menepis kemungkinan lain (wealth) dan menegaskan fokus yang benar (character).

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about the ultimate purpose of worship using cleft structure.
options: It is sincerity, above all else, that Allah looks for in our deeds
It sincerity is, above all else, that Allah looks for
Sincerity it is, above all else, that Allah looks for
It is sincerity which, above all else, Allah looks for
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menegaskan prinsip ibadah yang paling penting: keikhlasan.

quiz.question: Resilience ___ what carried the community through its darkest days.
quiz.explanation: Reversed Wh-Cleft: fokus (Resilience) di depan, diikuti 'is + what clause'.

quiz.question: ___ mattered to him in his final days was reconciling with his estranged family.
quiz.explanation: Wh-Cleft menekankan hal yang paling penting di akhir hidupnya.

quiz.question: Choose the correct All-Cleft emphasizing minimalism in a difficult request.
options: All we ask for is a chance to be heard fairly
What we ask for is a chance to be heard fairly (less minimalist nuance)
It is a chance we ask for to be heard fairly
That we ask for is a chance to be heard fairly
quiz.explanation: All-Cleft menekankan kesederhanaan permintaan yang sebenarnya sangat mendasar.

quiz.question: ___ was during that period of trial that his faith grew strongest.
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft menekankan periode waktu tertentu sebagai fokus utama.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence using cleft structure to sharpen a critical intellectual argument.
options: It is precisely this assumption that undermines the entire argument
It this assumption is that undermines the entire argument
This assumption it is that undermines the argument
It is this assumption which undermine the argument
quiz.explanation: It-Cleft mempertajam argumen dengan menonjolkan asumsi tertentu sebagai fokus kritis.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat It-Cleft yang menepis kemungkinan lain sebagai penyebab/pelaku. [HINT] It was X, not Y, that...
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat Reversed Wh-Cleft dengan fokus di depan untuk jawaban tegas dan mengejutkan. [HINT] [Focus] + is/was + what clause.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat All-Cleft untuk menunjukkan kesederhanaan/eksklusivitas permintaan atau keinginan. [HINT] All + klausa + is + fokus.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menegaskan prinsip keimanan (Haqq) menggunakan cleft sentence yang tegas. [HINT] Contoh: It is Allah who...
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat akademik mempertajam argumen intelektual menggunakan It-Cleft. [HINT] Fokuskan pada asumsi atau penyebab tertentu.

quiz.question: The committee's ___ of the proposal led to its rejection. (nominalize 'reject')
quiz.explanation: 'Rejection' adalah bentuk nominalisasi dari 'reject' (akhiran -tion).

quiz.question: Choose the correct preposition change: 'rely ON' becomes 'reliance ___'.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'on' tetap dipertahankan saat 'rely' dinominalisasi menjadi 'reliance'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct preposition change: 'differ FROM' becomes 'difference ___'.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'from' dipertahankan saat 'differ' dinominalisasi menjadi 'difference'.

quiz.question: The ___ between theory and practice often creates confusion. (nominalize 'differ')
quiz.explanation: 'Difference' adalah bentuk nominalisasi dari kata kerja 'differ'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence removing the human agent for scientific objectivity.
options: The implementation of the policy resulted in measurable improvements
The government implemented the policy and it resulted in improvements (less objective)
They implemented policy and got improvements
People implemented the policy resulting improvement
quiz.explanation: Nominalisasi ('implementation') menghilangkan agen manusia untuk kesan objektivitas ilmiah.

quiz.question: The mashdar (verbal noun) concept in Arabic parallels English nominalization in explaining concepts like:
options: Ikhlas, Sabr, Tawakkal as abstract nouns of faith
quiz.explanation: Mashdar dalam bahasa Arab mirip nominalisasi Inggris, dipakai untuk konsep abstrak keimanan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct preposition change: 'depend ON' becomes 'dependence ___'.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'on' dipertahankan saat 'depend' dinominalisasi menjadi 'dependence'.

quiz.question: The scholar's ___ on classical texts shaped his entire methodology. (nominalize 'rely')
quiz.explanation: 'Reliance' adalah nominalisasi dari 'rely', mempertahankan preposisi 'on'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence compressing cause, process, and result into one dense structure.
options: The gradual erosion of trust led to the organization's eventual collapse
Trust eroded gradually and this led the organization to eventually collapse (less compressed)
They eroded trust gradually, organization collapsed
Trust's erode gradual caused collapse organization
quiz.explanation: Nominalisasi ('erosion', 'collapse') mengemas sebab-proses-hasil dalam satu struktur padat.

quiz.question: The ___ of resources across departments improved overall efficiency. (nominalize 'distribute')
quiz.explanation: 'Distribution' adalah nominalisasi dari 'distribute' (akhiran -tion).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "His resistance to change was strong." — choose the preposition that follows.
quiz.explanation: 'Resist' diikuti objek langsung, tapi nominalisasinya 'resistance' memakai preposisi 'to'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct nominalization avoiding excessive personal pronouns in academic writing.
options: The analysis revealed a significant correlation between the variables
I analyzed and found a significant correlation
We analyzed data and we found correlation
quiz.explanation: Nominalisasi ('analysis') menghindari 'I/We' berlebihan, menciptakan objektivitas akademik.

quiz.question: The ___ of the ancient manuscript required years of careful study. (nominalize 'interpret')
quiz.explanation: 'Interpretation' adalah nominalisasi dari 'interpret' (akhiran -tion).

quiz.question: Choose the correct preposition change: 'insist ON' becomes 'insistence ___'.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'on' dipertahankan saat 'insist' dinominalisasi menjadi 'insistence'.

quiz.question: His unwavering ___ on justice earned him the community's trust. (nominalize 'insist')
quiz.explanation: 'Insistence' adalah bentuk kata benda dari 'insist', mempertahankan preposisi 'on'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence with the highest lexical density using nominalization.
options: The unprecedented expansion of trade fostered rapid economic transformation
Trade expanded a lot and this fostered economic change (less dense)
They expanded trade fast and economy transformed
Trade's expand caused economy change fast
quiz.explanation: Nominalisasi menciptakan kepadatan leksikal tinggi yang khas penulisan akademik tingkat tinggi.

quiz.question: The ___ of his character was evident even in his youth. (nominalize 'strong')
quiz.explanation: 'Strength' adalah bentuk nominalisasi dari kata sifat 'strong'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The government's decide to intervene caused controversy."
options: The government's decision to intervene caused controversy
The government's deciding to intervene caused controversy (less standard)
The government decide to intervene caused controversy
The government decision intervening caused controversy
quiz.explanation: 'Decision' adalah bentuk nominalisasi yang benar dari 'decide'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct preposition change: 'compete WITH' becomes 'competition ___'.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'with' dipertahankan saat 'compete' dinominalisasi menjadi 'competition'.

quiz.question: The intense ___ with rival scholars pushed him to refine his arguments. (nominalize 'compete')
quiz.explanation: 'Competition' adalah nominalisasi dari 'compete', mempertahankan preposisi 'with'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence explaining the concept of Tawakkal using dense nominal language.
options: Tawakkal embodies complete reliance upon Allah's wisdom and decree
To rely on Allah completely is called Tawakkal (more verb-focused, less nominal)
People who rely on Allah do Tawakkal
Relying completely on Allah is a Tawakkal action
quiz.explanation: 'Reliance' sebagai kata benda abstrak cocok untuk bahasa konseptual dalam menjelaskan Tawakkal.

quiz.question: The ___ of his argument was undermined by a single flawed assumption. (nominalize 'valid')
quiz.explanation: 'Validity' adalah nominalisasi dari kata sifat 'valid'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "His investigate of the matter revealed new evidence."
options: His investigation of the matter revealed new evidence
His investigating of the matter revealed new evidence (less standard)
His investigative of the matter revealed new evidence
His investigator of the matter revealed new evidence
quiz.explanation: 'Investigation' adalah bentuk nominalisasi yang benar dari 'investigate'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct preposition change: 'object TO' becomes 'objection ___'.
quiz.explanation: Preposisi 'to' dipertahankan saat 'object' dinominalisasi menjadi 'objection'.

quiz.question: His strong ___ to the proposal delayed its approval. (nominalize 'object')
quiz.explanation: 'Objection' adalah nominalisasi dari 'object', mempertahankan preposisi 'to'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence explaining a concept of faith with formal nominal density.
options: The persistence of one's Sabr amid adversity reflects spiritual maturity
Being patient a lot when things are hard shows you're spiritually mature (less formal)
People who are patient in hard times are mature
Patient people during hard times are mature spiritually
quiz.explanation: 'Persistence' sebagai nominalisasi menciptakan bahasa akademik yang padat untuk konsep Sabr.

quiz.question: The ___ of the two theories highlighted their fundamental incompatibility. (nominalize 'compare')
quiz.explanation: 'Comparison' adalah nominalisasi dari kata kerja 'compare'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "His contribute to the field was widely recognized."
options: His contribution to the field was widely recognized
His contributing to the field was widely recognized (less standard)
His contributive to the field was widely recognized
His contributor to the field was widely recognized (different meaning: a person)
quiz.explanation: 'Contribution' adalah bentuk nominalisasi yang benar dari 'contribute'.

quiz.question: The ___ between the two scholars' interpretations sparked centuries of debate. (nominalize 'differ')
quiz.explanation: 'Divergence' adalah nominalisasi tingkat lanjut untuk menggambarkan perbedaan pandangan.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence with the most formal, dense academic register using nominalization.
options: The proliferation of misinformation necessitates rigorous verification protocols
Misinformation spreads a lot, so we need to check things carefully (informal)
People spread misinformation, so verify things
quiz.explanation: Nominalisasi ('proliferation', 'verification') menciptakan register akademik yang sangat formal dan padat.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat nominalisasi yang mempertahankan preposisi asli kata kerjanya (rely on -> reliance on). [HINT] Preposisi sering tetap sama setelah nominalisasi.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat akademik yang menghilangkan agen manusia (I/We/People) menggunakan nominalisasi untuk objektivitas. [HINT] Fokus pada konsep, bukan pelaku.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat yang mengompresi sebab-proses-hasil dalam satu struktur nominalisasi padat. [HINT] Gabungkan beberapa kalimat pendek jadi satu kalimat efisien.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menjelaskan konsep keimanan (Ikhlas, Sabr, Tawakkal) menggunakan bahasa nominal yang padat, mirip konsep Mashdar. [HINT] Gunakan kata benda abstrak, bukan kata kerja.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat dengan register akademik sangat formal menggunakan nominalisasi tingkat lanjut. [HINT] Semakin padat dan objektif, semakin sesuai gaya akademik tinggi.

quiz.question: ___ you practice, ___ you become at speaking English.
quiz.explanation: Struktur proportional correlative: The + comparative..., the + comparative...

quiz.question: The harder he worked, ___ closer he got to his goal.
quiz.explanation: Kedua klausa membutuhkan 'the' di depan comparative: 'the closer'.

quiz.question: ___ sooner we start, the sooner we finish.
quiz.explanation: Struktur ini konsisten memakai 'The' di depan setiap comparative.

quiz.question: The more knowledge one gains, ___ humble one should become.
quiz.explanation: 'The more humble' adalah bentuk comparative yang benar untuk kata sifat panjang.

quiz.question: Choose the correct abbreviated form omitting subject and verb for fluent speech.
options: The sooner it is, the better it will be (also correct, less concise)
quiz.explanation: Dalam ucapan yang fasih, subjek dan kata kerja sering dihilangkan jika maknanya jelas.

quiz.question: The less you worry, ___ peace you will find.
quiz.explanation: Korelasi terbalik: less...the more, menunjukkan hubungan yang bertolak belakang.

quiz.question: ___ he speaks, ___ people seem to respect him.
quiz.explanation: Korelasi terbalik yang konsisten memakai 'the' di kedua klausa.

quiz.question: The more grateful you are, the more Allah ___ increase you, as promised in the Qur'an.
quiz.explanation: Ini merujuk pada janji Allah tentang syukur, memakai 'will' untuk menyatakan kepastian.

quiz.question: Choose the correlative using an adverb instead of an adjective.
options: The more carefully you plan, the more successful you'll be
The more careful you plan, the more successful you'll be (adjective, less precise for describing 'plan' as a verb)
The most carefully you plan, the most successful
More carefully you plan, more successful you'll be
quiz.explanation: 'Carefully' (adverb) menjelaskan cara melakukan aksi 'plan', bukan 'careful' (adjective).

quiz.question: This principle of correlation between gratitude and increase relates to which Islamic concept?
options: Only Qadar (fate) with no connection to action
quiz.explanation: Prinsip korelasi ini mencerminkan hubungan antara syukur (Shukr) dan bertambahnya nikmat, mendorong Muhasabah.

quiz.question: The more patient she remained, ___ the trial became for her to bear.
quiz.explanation: 'The easier' adalah comparative pendek yang benar dengan 'the' di depannya.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "More you give, more you receive in blessings."
options: The more you give, the more you receive in blessings
More you give, the more you receive
The more you give, more you receive
More you give, more you receive (wrong as is)
quiz.explanation: Kedua klausa proportional correlative membutuhkan 'the' di depan comparative.

quiz.question: ___ he understood the topic, the harder it became to explain simply.
quiz.explanation: 'The deeper' adalah comparative dengan 'the' yang benar.

quiz.question: The fewer distractions we have, ___ we can focus on our worship.
quiz.explanation: Korelasi: fewer (berkurang), the better (bertambah baiknya) menunjukkan korelasi terbalik.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence using an inverse proportional correlative.
options: The more he denies the truth, the further he strays from guidance
The more he denies the truth, the more he strays closer to guidance (contradictory meaning)
More he denies, more he strays closer
The less he denies, the further he strays
quiz.explanation: Semakin dia mengingkari kebenaran, semakin jauh dia tersesat — korelasi yang selaras (bukan terbalik dalam hal ini).

quiz.question: The more sincerely one worships, ___ meaningful the experience becomes.
quiz.explanation: 'The more meaningful' adalah comparative yang benar dengan 'the' di depannya.

quiz.question: ___ we reflect on our blessings, the more content we become.
quiz.explanation: Struktur konsisten memakai 'The more' di kedua klausa.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The quicker you learn, quicker you can teach others."
options: The quicker you learn, the quicker you can teach others
Quicker you learn, the quicker you can teach
The quicker you learn, quicker you teach (missing 'the')
Quicker you learn, quicker you teach
quiz.explanation: Kedua klausa membutuhkan 'the' di depan comparative masing-masing.

quiz.question: The busier our lives become, ___ we must guard our time for reflection.
quiz.explanation: 'The more' menunjukkan korelasi proporsional yang meningkat.

quiz.question: Choose the correct abbreviated correlative for a common piece of wisdom.
options: The bigger they are, the harder they fall
Bigger they are, harder they fall
quiz.explanation: Struktur lengkap dengan 'the' di kedua sisi adalah bentuk standar, meski sering disingkat dalam idiom populer.

quiz.question: The more we practice Muhasabah, ___ we become of our shortcomings.
quiz.explanation: 'The more aware' adalah comparative dengan 'the' yang benar.

quiz.question: ___ the storm raged, the calmer he remained in his faith.
quiz.explanation: 'The more fiercely' (adverb comparative) menjelaskan cara badai berlangsung.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The harder the test, more we must prepare."
options: The harder the test, the more we must prepare
The harder the test, more we prepare (missing 'the')
Harder the test, the more we must prepare
The hard the test, the more we must prepare
quiz.explanation: Klausa kedua juga membutuhkan 'the' sebelum comparative: 'the more'.

quiz.question: The more we give in charity, ___ our wealth seems to be blessed.
quiz.explanation: Korelasi proporsional konsisten memakai 'the more' di kedua klausa.

quiz.question: Choose the correct correlative describing an inverse relationship between pride and wisdom.
options: The more arrogant a person becomes, the less wisdom they truly possess
The more arrogant a person becomes, the more wisdom they possess (contradicts inverse logic)
The less arrogant, the less wise
quiz.explanation: Korelasi terbalik: semakin sombong, semakin berkurang kebijaksanaannya.

quiz.question: ___ diligently she studied, the more confident she felt before the exam.
quiz.explanation: 'The more diligently' (adverb comparative) menjelaskan cara belajar.

quiz.question: The stronger our faith (Iman), ___ we can face life's trials.
quiz.explanation: 'The better' adalah comparative yang benar dengan 'the' di depannya.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "The sooner you forgive, the sooner peace comes to your heart" — check correctness.
options: Sooner you forgive, sooner peace comes
The soon you forgive, the soon peace comes
The sooner you forgive, sooner peace comes
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini sudah benar, memakai 'the' konsisten di kedua klausa.

quiz.question: The deeper one's understanding of the Qur'an, ___ profound one's connection to Allah becomes.
quiz.explanation: 'The more profound' adalah comparative yang benar dengan 'the' di depannya.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting the Qur'anic promise about gratitude and increase.
options: The more you give thanks, the more He will increase you
More you give thanks, more He increases you
The more you give thanks, He will increase you (missing second 'the more')
You give thanks more, He increases you more
quiz.explanation: Ini merujuk pada janji Allah dalam Al-Qur'an tentang korelasi syukur dan bertambahnya nikmat.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat proportional correlative standar (The more..., the more...). [HINT] Kedua klausa butuh 'the' di depan comparative.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat korelasi terbalik (The less..., the more... atau sebaliknya). [HINT] Menunjukkan hubungan yang bertolak belakang.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan adverb comparative (more carefully, more fiercely) dalam struktur korelasi. [HINT] Adverb menjelaskan cara, bukan sifat benda.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang janji Allah terkait syukur dan bertambahnya nikmat menggunakan proportional correlative. [HINT] Contoh: The more grateful you are, the more He will increase you.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang Muhasabah (introspeksi diri) menggunakan struktur korelasi proporsional. [HINT] Hubungkan usaha introspeksi dengan kesadaran diri yang meningkat.

quiz.question: Sarah ordered tea and Ali ___ coffee. (gapping)
quiz.explanation: Gapping menghilangkan kata kerja di klausa kedua karena identik dengan klausa pertama.

quiz.question: Someone called me, but I don't know ___. (sluicing)
quiz.explanation: Sluicing hanya menyisakan kata tanya (who), membuang seluruh klausa yang mengikutinya.

quiz.question: "I think he'll come." "I don't think ___."
quiz.explanation: Substitution dengan 'so' menggantikan seluruh klausa yang sudah disebutkan.

quiz.question: He wanted to help, and she ___ too. (gapping with auxiliary retained)
quiz.explanation: 'Did' menggantikan seluruh frasa kata kerja 'wanted to help' pada klausa kedua.

quiz.question: Ahmad studied medicine, and his sister ___ law. (gapping)
quiz.explanation: Gapping menghilangkan kata kerja 'studied' pada klausa kedua karena sudah jelas dari konteks.

quiz.question: She said something important, but I couldn't quite make out ___. (sluicing)
quiz.explanation: Sluicing membuang klausa setelah kata tanya karena informasinya sudah tersirat dari konteks.

quiz.question: Ellipsis at the Master level operates on brevity based on:
options: global context, not just the immediate sentence
quiz.explanation: Di level Master, ellipsis membuang kata yang sudah terwakili oleh konteks global, bukan hanya konteks kalimat.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He wanted to leave early, and she wanted too."
options: He wanted to leave early, and she did too
He wanted to leave early, and she wanted to too (also correct but less concise)
He wanted to leave early, and she want too
He wanted to leave early, and she wanting too
quiz.explanation: 'Did' adalah substitution yang tepat untuk mengganti seluruh frasa kata kerja sebelumnya.

quiz.question: The concept of Jawami'ul Kalim (comprehensive yet concise speech) is best embodied by:
options: gapping and sluicing, which maximize meaning with minimal words
quiz.explanation: Gapping dan sluicing adalah wujud linguistik dari prinsip berbicara ringkas namun padat makna.

quiz.question: He bought a car, and I ___ a motorcycle. (gapping)
quiz.explanation: Gapping menghilangkan 'bought' pada klausa kedua karena identik dengan klausa pertama.

quiz.question: "He's hiding something." "I wonder ___." (sluicing)
quiz.explanation: Sluicing hanya menyisakan kata tanya, membuang klausa yang sudah tersirat.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I don't know why did he leave."
options: I don't know why he left
I don't know why (sluicing, also correct if context is clear)
I don't know why did he leave (wrong as is)
I don't know why he did leave
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'why' dalam klausa tak langsung, tidak memakai inversi 'did he'.

quiz.question: She teaches literature, and her colleague ___ history. (gapping)
quiz.explanation: Gapping menghilangkan 'teaches' pada klausa kedua karena sudah identik dengan klausa pertama.

quiz.question: Someone left a message, but nobody knows ___. (sluicing)
quiz.explanation: Sluicing membuang klausa setelah kata tanya 'who' karena maknanya sudah jelas dari konteks.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence demonstrating concise, meaningful speech (Jawami'ul Kalim).
options: A long-winded explanation repeating the same simple point
Repeating the full question in every answer
quiz.explanation: Ellipsis mencerminkan komunikasi yang ringkas namun tetap lengkap maknanya.

quiz.question: "Will she attend the meeting?" "I hope ___."
quiz.explanation: 'I hope so' adalah substitution standar untuk harapan afirmatif.

quiz.question: He plays the guitar, and his brother ___ the piano. (gapping)
quiz.explanation: Gapping menghilangkan 'plays' pada klausa kedua.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He knows the answer, but he won't tell what."
options: He knows the answer, but he won't tell what it is
He knows the answer, but he won't tell what (sluicing needs the question word only, not partial)
He knows the answer, but he won't tell what is (wrong word order)
He knows the answer, but he won't tell it what
quiz.explanation: Sluicing yang benar membuang klausa sepenuhnya setelah kata tanya, atau tetap menyertakan klausa penuh; campuran keduanya menjadi janggal.

quiz.question: Someone is knocking, but I don't know ___. (sluicing)
quiz.explanation: Sluicing hanya menyisakan kata tanya 'who'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct gapping structure with parallel objects.
options: The teacher praised Ali, and the principal, Sarah
The teacher praised Ali, and the principal praised Sarah (full form, not gapped)
The teacher praised Ali, and the principal Sarah praised (wrong order)
The teacher praised Ali, and Sarah the principal
quiz.explanation: Gapping ekstrem bisa menghilangkan kata kerja sepenuhnya jika struktur paralel jelas: 'and the principal, Sarah'.

quiz.question: "Is he coming?" "I doubt ___."
quiz.explanation: 'I doubt it' adalah substitution standar untuk keraguan, menggantikan seluruh klausa.

quiz.question: He finished his project, and she ___ hers. (gapping/substitution)
quiz.explanation: 'Finished' diulang secara paralel (gapping tidak berlaku di sini karena objeknya beda; ini contoh parallel repetition, bukan penghilangan).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I know he's upset, but I don't know about why."
options: I know he's upset, but I don't know why
I know he's upset, but I don't know about why (redundant preposition)
I know he's upset, but I don't know for why
I know he's upset, but I don't know of why
quiz.explanation: Sluicing yang tepat: 'I don't know why' tanpa preposisi tambahan yang redundan.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting brevity based on global (not just sentential) context.
options: "Confirmed." (referring to an entire prior discussion, not just the last sentence)
"I confirm that the meeting discussed earlier today is confirmed."
"Yes, I am confirming the thing we were just talking about in detail."
"Confirmed, as I said in my previous long message about this topic."
quiz.explanation: Ellipsis di level master membuang kata berdasarkan konteks global percakapan, bukan hanya kalimat terakhir.

quiz.question: He apologized, and she ___ too. (substitution)
options: apologized (full form, also correct but less concise)
quiz.explanation: 'Did' menggantikan 'apologized' secara ringkas.

quiz.question: Someone reported the issue, but I'm not sure ___. (sluicing)
quiz.explanation: Sluicing membuang klausa setelah kata tanya 'who'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence demonstrating gapping with a clear parallel structure.
options: Fatimah recited Surah Al-Baqarah, and her brother, Surah Yasin
Fatimah recited Surah Al-Baqarah, and her brother recited Surah Yasin (full form, not gapped)
Fatimah recited Surah Al-Baqarah, and Surah Yasin her brother
Fatimah, Surah Al-Baqarah, and recited her brother Surah Yasin
quiz.explanation: Gapping menghilangkan kata kerja 'recited' pada klausa kedua karena strukturnya paralel dan jelas.

quiz.question: "Did they agree?" "I believe ___."
quiz.explanation: 'I believe so' adalah substitution standar untuk jawaban afirmatif ringkas.

quiz.question: He offered advice, but I'm not sure ___ (sluicing, referring to what kind).
options: what kind of advice he offered
quiz.explanation: Sluicing menyisakan frasa tanya 'what kind' dan membuang sisanya.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence reflecting the highest level of concise, meaningful Islamic speech (Jawami'ul Kalim).
options: "La ilaha illallah" — a complete declaration of faith in four words
A lengthy paragraph explaining the same simple declaration
Repeating the declaration multiple times unnecessarily
Adding many extra words to a simple truth
quiz.explanation: Kalimat syahadat adalah contoh puncak dari Jawami'ul Kalim — ringkas namun mengandung makna yang sangat dalam.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan Gapping (menghilangkan kata kerja di klausa kedua yang identik). [HINT] Contoh: She ordered tea, and he, coffee.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan Sluicing (menyisakan kata tanya, membuang klausa setelahnya). [HINT] Contoh: Someone called, but I don't know who.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat substitution menggunakan so/not/do untuk menggantikan klausa yang sudah disebutkan. [HINT] I think so, I hope not, dst.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat yang membuang kata berdasarkan konteks global percakapan, bukan hanya kalimat terakhir. [HINT] Pikirkan konteks keseluruhan percakapan.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat yang mencerminkan Jawami'ul Kalim (ringkas namun padat makna) menggunakan ellipsis tingkat lanjut. [HINT] Semakin ringkas namun tetap jelas maknanya, semakin baik.

quiz.question: ___ that the negotiations will resume next week.
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive 'It is believed that...' menyampaikan informasi tanpa menyebut sumber spesifik.

quiz.question: He is said ___ one of the most influential scholars of his generation.
quiz.explanation: Pola infinitif setelah To Be + V3: 'is said to be'.

quiz.question: Choose a more nuanced reporting verb than 'say' implying doubt.
quiz.explanation: 'Allege' menunjukkan klaim yang belum terbukti, memberi nuansa keraguan.

quiz.question: The suspect is alleged ___ committed the offense, though this remains unproven.
quiz.explanation: Pola perfect infinitive: 'is alleged to have committed' untuk merujuk pada masa lalu.

quiz.question: ___ that the crisis has had far-reaching economic consequences.
quiz.explanation: Passive Continuous + Impersonal Passive: 'It is being reported that...' menunjukkan berita yang sedang berkembang.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence avoiding Fitnah (baseless slander) by properly attributing uncertain claims.
options: It is alleged that he was involved, though this has not been confirmed
He was definitely involved, everyone knows it
He is guilty, no question about it
Everyone says he did it, so it must be true
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan bahasa yang berhati-hati (alleged, unconfirmed) membantu menghindari fitnah dalam menyampaikan informasi yang belum jelas.

quiz.question: The ancient manuscript is thought ___ over a thousand years old.
quiz.explanation: Pola infinitif: 'is thought to be' menghubungkan subjek dengan status.

quiz.question: ___ that the new regulations will take effect by next quarter.
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive dengan Present Perfect: 'It has been announced that...'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct reporting verb suggesting strong but unverified accusation.
quiz.explanation: 'Claim' menunjukkan pernyataan yang belum tentu terbukti kebenarannya.

quiz.question: He is claimed ___ significant contributions to the field, though details remain scarce.
quiz.explanation: Perfect infinitive 'to have made' merujuk pada aksi yang diklaim terjadi di masa lalu.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "It is say that the region has changed significantly."
options: It is said that the region has changed significantly
It says that the region has changed significantly
It is saying that the region has changed significantly
It has say that the region has changed
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive membutuhkan Verb 3: 'said'.

quiz.question: ___ that further reforms are being considered by the committee.
quiz.explanation: 'It is understood that...' adalah pola impersonal passive standar untuk informasi yang dipahami secara umum.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence maintaining careful distance from unverified rumors (avoiding Ghibah/Fitnah).
options: It is rumored that changes may occur, though nothing is confirmed
Everyone knows he's guilty, it's obvious
It's definitely true, no doubt at all
I heard it from someone, so it must be true
quiz.explanation: Menjaga jarak dari rumor yang belum terverifikasi mencerminkan kehati-hatian terhadap fitnah dan ghibah.

quiz.question: The treaty is expected ___ within the coming months.
quiz.explanation: Pola pasif infinitif: 'is expected to be signed'.

quiz.question: ___ that the situation is being closely monitored by relevant authorities.
quiz.explanation: Impersonal Passive dengan Passive Continuous di dalamnya: 'It is understood that... is being monitored'.

quiz.question: Choose a reporting verb implying a suggestion rather than a firm claim.
quiz.explanation: 'Suggest' menunjukkan usulan/kemungkinan, bukan kepastian mutlak.

quiz.question: It is suggested ___ additional measures may be necessary going forward.
quiz.explanation: 'It is suggested that...' adalah pola impersonal passive standar dengan 'that'.
